title: Cook-at-home tools for non-restaurant nights
intro: Soft CTAs for established grocery and meal-kit patterns when you are balancing sit-down restaurant nights with cooking at home. Confirm coverage, box prices and baskets on each site — this block is not a ranking of restaurants.
